# Phase Two — Gevurah Studio Critique

The Awtsmoos cuts through the temptation to modernize only what shines;
Awtsmoos.com becomes stronger when every visible control and internal owner obeys the same measured lines.

## Twenty-five refinements

1. Do not touch dead `modules/studio.js` in this wave unless another entry proves it live.
2. Do not touch giant `index.html` yet; preserve existing IDs and shell markup while moving visual ownership into loaded CSS/modules.
3. Treat `style.left/width` for clip/time geometry as legitimate runtime state, not style debt by default.
4. Remove decorative inline styles from property rendering because those are static presentation.
5. Replace inline event attributes with listeners through factories/controllers.
6. Preserve every `window.Studio` public action name until all live consumers are migrated.
7. Keep property rendering data-driven so Global/Clip/FX can expand without HTML concatenation.
8. Use semantic labels linked to controls where practical.
9. Use `details` only where it improves disclosure; do not bury frequently used Start/Duration/Volume.
10. Keep destructive Delete visually secondary to primary adjustment controls until intentionally invoked.
11. Make tab buttons >=44px on phone even if desktop remains compact.
12. Never shrink toolbar buttons to 26px on mobile again.
13. Mobile timeline labels may narrow, but actions must stay reachable with horizontal/internal scroll rather than viewport escape.
14. Drawer layer must use named token, not 200.
15. FAB must use named floating layer, not 9999.
16. Snap guide/playhead/block selected/hover layers need named Studio-local tokens.
17. Use `touch-action` deliberately on drag/trim handles and resizer.
18. Prefer Pointer Events for new interaction controllers rather than parallel mouse/touch branches.
19. Preserve reduced-motion for drawer/button/hover transitions.
20. Add short-height rules so preview/properties/timeline actions remain reachable at 568px height.
21. Do not make the property panel itself the scroll trap; only inner content should scroll.
22. Ensure color/range/checkbox focus rings are visible against dark glass.
23. Ensure textareas have deliberate resize behavior and max size within the panel.
24. Split tests by visual-contract/source-contract, not brittle implementation line coincidence.
25. After visual/property wave, re-read oversized actions/project/interaction and split them as separate code wave before declaring Studio complete.
